summary: Quantum BioPharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 6, 2026, announcing a Study Start-Up Agreement with Thermo Fisher Scientific's clinical research business to implement the Phase 2 Lucid-MS trial in multiple sclerosis. The contract covers study start-up and related clinical research services for a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating Lucid-MS in progressive MS, following FDA clearance. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are present; this is an ordinary clinical-services contract and does not constitute a special situation.
